{{< include includes/preprint-citation.md >}}

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
source(if (file.exists("supplement/report-helpers.R")) "supplement/report-helpers.R" else "report-helpers.R")

families <- tibble::tribble(
  ~bundle, ~label, ~within,
  "supplement_primary_update_2026", "Primary prescribed supplement", FALSE,
  "supplement_mundlak_update_2026", "Mundlak decomposition", FALSE,
  "supplement_within_update_2026", "Strict within-study", TRUE,
  "supplement_rescor_update_2026", "Residual correlation", FALSE,
  "supplement_strategy_update_2026", "Strategy, arm level", FALSE,
  "supplement_strategy_within_update_2026", "Strategy, within study", TRUE
) |>
  mutate(
    data = map(bundle, ~ read_bundle(.x, "sample_rows.csv.gz")),
    predictions = map2(bundle, label, ~ normalise_predictions(read_bundle(.x, "dose_response_predictions.csv.gz"), .y, "g/day")),
    diagnostics = map2(bundle, label, diagnostic_row),
    equivalence = map2(bundle, label, local_equivalence_summary)
  )

samples <- pmap_dfr(
  list(families$data, families$label, families$within),
  analysis_sample_row
)
diagnostics <- bind_rows(families$diagnostics)
predictions <- bind_rows(families$predictions) |>
  mutate(outcome = factor(outcome, levels = unname(report_outcome_labels)))
equivalence <- bind_rows(families$equivalence)

primary_predictions_raw <- read_bundle("supplement_primary_update_2026", "dose_response_predictions.csv.gz")
support <- primary_predictions_raw |>
  group_by(outcome, resistance_exercise) |>
  summarise(
    central_min = first(central_90_minimum),
    central_max = first(central_90_maximum),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
meaningful <- read_bundle("supplement_primary_update_2026", "supported_meaningful_contrasts.csv.gz") |>
  filter(
    supported %in% TRUE,
    protein_intake_proposed > protein_intake_current,
    probability_meaningful_benefit >= 0.95 | probability_meaningful_detriment >= 0.95
  ) |>
  left_join(support, by = c("outcome", "resistance_exercise")) |>
  mutate(
    within_central_90 = protein_intake_current >= central_min & protein_intake_proposed <= central_max,
    Outcome = unname(report_outcome_labels[outcome]),
    `RT condition` = report_rt_label(resistance_exercise)
  )
```

# Scope

This post-registration programme uses prescribed supplemental protein in g/day. It represents the assigned product dose, not achieved total intake and not an adherence-adjusted consumed dose. A structural zero was assigned only to an explicit control or placebo arm with a missing prescribed dose. Reported comparator protein was retained, and a missing protein-arm dose remained missing.

The primary, Mundlak, strict within-study, residual-correlation, and arm-level and within-study Addition-versus-Substitution families were applicable. Separate achieved-versus-assignment models were not fitted because prescribed supplement dose is already the assignment exposure and systematically measured achieved supplement dose was unavailable. An errors-in-variables family was not fitted because a fixed prescription has no corresponding dietary measurement-error input. Each outcome retained 18 candidates after omitting the relative-scale 1.6-g/kg/day spline family.

# Final samples and diagnostics

```{r}
#| label: tbl-supplement-samples
#| tbl-cap: "Prescribed-supplement analysis samples."
samples |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(is.na(.x), "—", format_count(.x)))) |>
  knitr::kable(align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "l"))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-supplement-diagnostics
#| tbl-cap: "Final sampling and exact-LOO diagnostic status."
knitr::kable(diagnostics, align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r"))
```

All six families passed their final reporting gates. Stacking was estimated within outcome and family from the corrected observation-level LOO objects.

# Dose-response results

```{r}
#| label: fig-supplement-curves
#| fig-cap: "Model-averaged prescribed-supplement dose-response curves for non-strategy arm-level analyses. The ribbon shows the primary 95% posterior interval."
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 9

arm <- predictions |> filter(is.na(strategy), !analysis %in% "Strict within-study")
primary <- arm |> filter(analysis == "Primary prescribed supplement")

ggplot(arm, aes(dose, estimate, colour = analysis)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = primary,
    aes(ymin = conf_low, ymax = conf_high, fill = analysis),
    alpha = 0.15, colour = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.65) +
  facet_grid(rt ~ outcome, scales = "free_y", labeller = report_facet_labels()) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = report_curve_colours) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = report_curve_colours, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = report_dose_axes[["supplement"]], y = "Standardised Mean Change", colour = NULL) +
  report_theme()
```

The main pattern is compatible with both the relative-intake and absolute-total-intake analyses: modest positive curves for whole-body lean/fat-free mass, measures of muscle size or mass, and strength, with shallower or more uncertain patterns for physical function.

## Supported meaningful contrasts

```{r}
#| label: tbl-supplement-meaningful
#| tbl-cap: "Supported primary contrasts meeting the 95% probability criterion for a meaningful benefit or detriment."

meaningful_display <- meaningful |>
  group_by(Outcome, `RT condition`) |>
  summarise(
    `Lowest current dose` = min(protein_intake_current),
    `Highest proposed dose` = max(protein_intake_proposed),
    `Maximum meaningful-benefit probability` = max(probability_meaningful_benefit),
    `Any wholly within central 90%` = any(within_central_90),
    `Supported contrasts` = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(`Maximum meaningful-benefit probability` = sprintf("%.3f", `Maximum meaningful-benefit probability`))

if (nrow(meaningful_display)) {
  knitr::kable(meaningful_display, align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"))
} else {
  cat("No supported contrast met the 95% meaningful-difference criterion.")
}
```

Only very widely separated whole-body lean/fat-free-mass contrasts in the RT stratum met the meaningful-benefit criterion. None lay wholly within the central 90% supplement-dose range. The high-dose tail therefore does not provide a precise supplementation target.

# Addition-versus-Substitution

```{r}
#| label: fig-supplement-strategy
#| fig-cap: "Addition and Substitution curves for the arm-level and within-study prescribed-supplement strategy analyses."
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 10

strategy <- predictions |>
  filter(!is.na(strategy)) |>
  mutate(panel = paste(analysis, unname(report_rt_display[rt]), sep = "\n"))

ggplot(strategy, aes(dose, estimate, colour = strategy, fill = strategy)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf_low, ymax = conf_high), alpha = 0.10, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.65) +
  facet_grid(panel ~ outcome, scales = "free_y", labeller = report_facet_labels()) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = report_curve_colours) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = report_curve_colours) +
  labs(x = report_dose_axes[["supplement"]], y = "Standardised Mean Change or Contrast", colour = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  report_theme()
```

The strategy analyses do not establish a general advantage for Addition or Substitution. Their between-strategy component remains largely a study-level comparison.

# Local practical equivalence

```{r}
#| label: tbl-supplement-equivalence
#| tbl-cap: "Local practical-equivalence radii in prescribed g/day."
equivalence |>
  mutate(
    across(c(equivalent_radius, equivalent_radius_q10, equivalent_radius_q90), ~ sprintf("%.1f", .x)),
    supported_current_intakes = format_count(supported_current_intakes)
  ) |>
  rename(
    `Median radius` = equivalent_radius,
    `Q10 radius` = equivalent_radius_q10,
    `Q90 radius` = equivalent_radius_q90,
    `Supported current intakes` = supported_current_intakes
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(align = "l")
```

# Interpretation

The prescribed-supplement programme does not materially change the overall interpretation. Nearby supported doses are commonly practically equivalent. Evidence for a meaningful gain is limited to very wide, sparsely represented whole-body contrasts during RT, and no supported meaningful contrast was identified for the other outcomes. These models address assignment to a supplement dose more directly than achieved-intake models, but cross-trial dose comparisons and variation in adherence, background diet, product composition, and co-interventions remain important limitations.
